title: NFToken
key_points: NFToken is a custom data type in the XRP Ledger that represents a non-fungible token (NFT).
It allows for the creation and management of unique digital assets on the XRP Ledger.
NFTokens are built using the existing account-based structure of the XRP Ledger, making them compatible with XRP transactions.
The NFToken schema defines the properties and behaviors of NFTs in the XRP Ledger.
limitations: This documentation may not cover all possible use cases or edge cases for creating and using NFTokens in the XRP Ledger.
It assumes a basic understanding of the XRP Ledger's functionality and concepts.
asserts: NFToken is a custom data type in the XRP Ledger that represents non-fungible tokens (NFTs), enabling the creation and management of unique digital assets within the XRP Ledger ecosystem.
scope: Describes the NFToken custom data type, its properties, and behavior within the context of the XRP Ledger.
